name: 3D Aquarium Paris
summary: A visit to the aquarium is a special experience, especially if you can watch it on video afterwards. In this case as a real 3D video in the Meta Quest. The video format is in FSBS format in 4K and is streamed to the glasses. The left and right images are projected onto the left and right eyes. Content: It shows sequences from the Aquarium Paris (near the Eiffel Tower) and Sea Life Paris (a little outside). Total length: 20 min.
